name: Hourly EMA50/EMA200 crossover baseline
source: Local data/historical_1h CSV archives; no network data

rules.entry: Next bar open after closed-bar EMA crossover; LONG upward, SHORT downward
rules.stop_gap: Adverse open fill; losses can exceed planned risk
rules.target_gap: Fill at target, without favorable gap improvement
rules.segment_boundary: Close at final bar close; do not carry positions between periods

warmup: Earlier bars may initialize causal indicators, but cannot open a position in the evaluation period
parameter_search: None; do not tune after observing any period

statistical_check.criteria: Both validation and final test must have positive average net R, a positive 95% bootstrap lower bound, and p*3 <= 0.05; final test must remain positive at stress cost
statistical_check.scope: Research screen only, never permission for live orders; final period has appeared in other project research and is not a sealed external holdout
